body: A programming framework for agentic AI
plain_description: **Build multi-agent AI applications that can work autonomously or alongside people.** Use it to prototype agent workflows with code or AutoGen Studio’s no-code interface. The project is archived and no longer maintained; its maintainers advise against production use.
technical_description: AutoGen is a Python and .NET framework for creating multi-agent AI applications. It provides core message passing and runtimes, AgentChat APIs for common multi-agent patterns, and extensions for model clients and tools. AutoGen Studio offers a no-code interface for prototyping workflows. The repository is archived and no longer maintained.
title: AutoGen
